ideas.title: The Aimee Bock Connection: Uncovering the Web of Deceit in Minnesota's COVID Relief Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate Aimee Bock's role in the $250 million Feeding Our Future COVID relief fraud scheme and potential connections to other entities and officials.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and explore the network of individuals and organizations involved
questions: What was Aimee Bock's exact role in the scheme?
How far did the fraud network extend?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a complex web of deceit involving government funds and potentially high-ranking officials.

ideas.title: Minnesota Child Care Centers: A Hotbed of Fraud?
ideas.description: Explore allegations of widespread fraud in Minnesota's child care sector and potential systemic issues
ideas.angle: Investigative report on fraud in child care centers
questions: What systemic issues allowed this to happen?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight significant oversight failures and potential fraud within Minnesota's child care programs.
